title: Entity Store
text: Store entities, 1 input, 6 outputs; {Capacity} sets the capacity of the storage, {Number of entities departed, d} sets the outputs the number of entities that have departed, {Number of entities in block, n} sets the outputs the number of entities present in the block, which have yet, {Average wait, w} sets the outputs the average wait time, {Average store size, l} sets the outputs the average store size and {Number of entities extracted, ex} sets the number of entities extracted from this. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_d
ports.summary: Number of entities that have departed the block scalar

ports.name: Port_n
ports.summary: Number of entities that have not yet departed the block scalar

ports.name: Port_w
ports.summary: Average wait time for entities in the block scalar

params.name: Capacity
params.values: Specify the capacity of the storage 25 (default) | scalar

params.values: Outputs the number of entities that have departed the block off (default) | on

params.values: Outputs the number of entities present in the block, which have yet to depart off (default) | on

params.name: Average wait, w
params.values: Outputs the average wait time off (default) | on

params.name: Average store size, l
params.values: Outputs the average store size off (default) | on

params.values: Number of entities extracted from this block off (default) | on
